title: Cyberpunk 2077
provenance: user reports on Highball (highball-db#2 M4, #3 M5, OdynOOb), wine-10.0 Sikarugir r6; previously community consensus (AppleGamingWiki / r-macgaming)
notes: Playable. M4: ~17 fps avg, 1920x1200 Steam Deck preset + FSR 2.1. M5: 60-82 fps in gameplay (Metal HUD; the built-in benchmark's summary under-reads because of first-frames shader compilation), fullscreen 1920x1200, FSR 2.1 Balanced, ray-traced local shadows ON. Mandatory: Advertise AVX ON (engine crashes at launch otherwise); Steam launch option --launcher-skip (REDlauncher fails on OpenGL context / libEGL.dll); Steam Overlay OFF (black screen). Fullscreen beats borderless for frame pacing. First runs stutter while shaders compile, then settle. See recipe cyberpunk-2077.
